title: Claidex MCP

environmentVariables.description: Claidex API key for protected tools and resources.

environmentVariables.description: Claidex API key for protected tools and resources.

environmentVariables.name: CLAIDEX_MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Claidex API key for protected tools and resources.

toolsPreview.name: claidex_capabilities
toolsPreview.description: Return the Claidex MCP feature map, configured storage/model providers, safety controls, resources, prompts, and tool counts.

toolsPreview.name: claidex_claim_risk_matrix
toolsPreview.description: Search claims and summarize MRS bands, trial phases, failure archetypes, and high-risk programs for rapid diligence.

toolsPreview.name: claidex_health_snapshot
toolsPreview.description: Return Sentinel metrics, coverage, graph counts, recent automation runs, MRS bands, and preprint-watch summaries.

toolsPreview.name: claidex_research_prompt
toolsPreview.description: Compose a rigorous, reusable investigation prompt that tells an MCP client which Claidex tools and resources to use.

toolsPreview.name: claidex_tool_catalog
toolsPreview.description: Return the complete MCP tool catalog, optionally including full input schemas and filtering native versus agent-backed tools.

toolsPreview.name: consult_specialist_model
toolsPreview.description: Ask a specialist Gateway model for code, database/tool-calling, statistics, literature, preprint, or mechanistic synthesis support. Use for hard subproblems, second opinions, code generation/review, or complex synthesis.

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a specific result returned by search. This compatibility tool supports OpenAI and ChatGPT remote MCP retrieval flows.

toolsPreview.name: fetch_research_url
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a public HTTPS research URL, JSON API response, package metadata endpoint, documentation page, or dataset preview. Blocks private/internal hosts and truncates large responses.

toolsPreview.name: get_claim_content
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the complete text content of a specific Claidex Claim by its slug. Use this when you need to read the full post-mortem analysis, including hypothesis, failure mechanism, and prevention analysis.

toolsPreview.name: query_chembl
toolsPreview.description: Look up a drug or compound in ChEMBL. Returns mechanism of action, primary target, ChEMBL ID, max development phase, molecular type, and synonyms.

toolsPreview.name: query_clinicaltrials
toolsPreview.description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for clinical trials. Can search by drug name, condition, target, or NCT ID. Returns trial status, phase, sponsor, primary endpoints, and why_stopped if terminated.

toolsPreview.name: query_failure_graph
toolsPreview.description: Query the Claidex failure graph for a specific gene target. Returns the Mechanism Risk Score (MRS), failure counts by phase and archetype, and all related claim slugs.

toolsPreview.name: query_openfda
toolsPreview.description: Query the FDA FAERS database for adverse event signals for a drug. Returns top adverse event terms, serious case count, and death count.

toolsPreview.name: query_opentargets
toolsPreview.description: Query Open Targets for target-disease association evidence. Returns genetic evidence score, clinical evidence, known drugs, tractability, and safety liabilities for a gene-disease pair.

toolsPreview.name: query_package_registry
toolsPreview.description: Look up package metadata from npm or PyPI before recommending code, analysis packages, API clients, or dataset tooling.

toolsPreview.name: rank_documents_by_embedding
toolsPreview.description: Embed a query and candidate documents, then rank documents by cosine similarity. Use for semantic matching, retrieval checks, clustering triage, and lightweight RAG over user-provided passages.

toolsPreview.name: rerank_documents
toolsPreview.description: Rerank candidate documents/passages against a query using a dedicated reranking model. Use after retrieval/search when exact relevance ordering matters.

toolsPreview.name: run_computation
toolsPreview.description: Evaluate deterministic mathematical expressions with optional variables. Use for algebra, matrices, vectors, transformations, descriptive numerical checks, and reproducible calculations. Does not execute arbitrary JavaScript or install packages.

toolsPreview.name: run_statistical_analysis
toolsPreview.description: Run a statistical analysis computation. Supports: Wilson confidence intervals, binomial proportions, phase transition success rates, power calculations, Bayesian posterior estimates, descriptive statistics, and two-proportion comparisons. Returns computed values, interpretation, and LaTeX formula.

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search Claidex failure claims and preprint flags. This compatibility tool returns citation-ready results for OpenAI and ChatGPT remote MCP flows.

toolsPreview.name: search_claims
toolsPreview.description: Search the Claidex failure database for post-mortems matching a drug name, gene target, disease, failure archetype, or sponsor. Returns matching claims with title, slug, drug, target, disease, phase, failure archetype, Open Targets score, and MRS score.

toolsPreview.name: search_preprint_flags
toolsPreview.description: Search the Claidex Preprint Watch database for bioRxiv preprints flagged as contradicting the clinical failure record. Search by target gene, disease, or preprint title.

toolsPreview.name: search_pubmed
toolsPreview.description: Search PubMed for biomedical literature. Returns title, authors, journal, year, DOI, abstract, and PMID for each result.

toolsPreview.name: web_search
toolsPreview.description: Search the web for recent news, investor commentary, analyst notes, press releases, and conference coverage about drugs, clinical trials, or biomedical mechanisms.
